title: BOHM：复合AI系统的零成本分层归因方法
summary: BOHM是一种零成本的分层归因方法，通过从路由权重中提取归因树，无需访问组件内部或评估任意子集，即可提供多分辨率归因。实验表明，在多个层次结构上，BOHM与SHAP高度相关（Kendall tau最高0.928），但计算成本仅为SHAP的极小部分，适用于第三方API和代理编排器等场景。
summary_en: BOHM is a zero-cost hierarchical attribution method that extracts an attribution tree from routing weights, requiring no access to component internals or evaluation of arbitrary subsets. It provides multi-resolution attribution and achieves high correlation with SHAP (Kendall tau up to 0.928) at a fraction of the computational cost, suitable for third-party APIs and agentic orchestrators.
